# Emanuel Hernández Castillo — emanuelhc.ai

> Personal site of Emanuel Hernández Castillo, a fractional CTO and AI systems architect based in Costa Rica. He offers tech leadership for startups and SMBs building with AI: fractional CTO, technical interviews and hiring, architecture review and technical due diligence, and AI agents in production. Background: GPU software at Intel, data science for Apple (TV+, App Store, Music), ML team lead roles, then co-founder and CTO of Skillful AI, an enterprise agentic AI platform. In 2026 he builds potenci (https://potenci.ai), a business OS with native AI agents, and runs AI agents in production for real businesses. Works in Spanish and English.

## Services

- Fractional CTO: part-time technical leadership for startups and SMBs. Architecture and roadmap, build vs buy, hiring and running the engineering team, vendor and AI tooling decisions, technical voice with investors and clients. Pricing: custom, scoped in a free discovery call.
- Technical interviews & hiring: hiring loop design, technical interviews for backend, AI and data engineers, written evaluations per candidate, help closing hires. Pricing: custom, scoped in discovery.
- Architecture review & technical due diligence: for founders or investors. Audit of a system or startup, ranked risks, written report and action plan. Pricing: custom, scoped in discovery.
- AI agents in production: design, build and operate agents (WhatsApp, booking, quoting). Pricing: 50-hour block, $10,000.
- Consulting hour: $200 per hour, written notes after the call.
- Discovery call: free, 15 minutes, via the form at https://emanuelhc.ai/#discovery.

## Flagship case study

- [Ten Months Running a WhatsApp AI Agent in Production: The Francesca Case Study](https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/whatsapp-ai-agent-ten-months-production): Francesca books appointments on WhatsApp for a grooming spa chain in Bogotá. 234,000+ messages and 6,300+ conversations in ten months. With automatic mode on (Sep 23 – Nov 10, 2026): median first reply ~50 seconds vs ~17 minutes for the human team, 99.7% of AI replies under five minutes, after-hours conversations answered up from 60.3% to 87.4%, 377 appointments booked by the agent in seven weeks, and unanswered conversations down from 72.8% (March) to 7.8% (November). Covers the month the client switched the agent off, why assisted mode failed (about 3% of drafts were approved), gated writes, moving rules from prompt to tools, silent outages behind green dashboards, and two-way calendar sync.
- [Diez meses operando un agente de IA en WhatsApp: el caso de Francesca](https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/agente-ia-whatsapp-diez-meses-produccion): Spanish version of the Francesca case study.

## Other writing

- [We Swapped the Brain of a Production AI Agent and Measured Whether Its Personality Survived](https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/swapping-llm-production-agent-personality): Changing the LLM behind a production WhatsApp receptionist with a byte-identical persona prompt, and measuring what transferred and what silently changed. Spanish: https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/swapping-llm-production-agent-personality-es
- [What 27,000 WhatsApp Conversations Taught Me About Production AI Agents](https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/whatsapp-ai-agent-production-case-study): Production case study of an AI sales agent for a Colombian fabric retailer. Grounded tool calling vs. model knowledge, versioned agent configuration, human handoff design, multimodal search. Spanish: https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/whatsapp-ai-agent-production-case-study-es
- [Human-in-the-loop for voice agents: why your architecture decides whether it's possible](https://emanuelhc.ai/writing/voice-agent-hitl-architecture): Cascaded vs. native speech-to-speech tradeoffs, and why the architecture choice decides whether human review before delivery is possible.
